items.text: Hello adventurers!
We’re glad to present Update 2.5.0 to you! Meet numerous bug fixes, network connection improvements, puzzle changes, improvements, and a lot of camera angle fixes.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/c2ddf24d3bd5f7ff1e4377f22d0e7f30df57bd40.png"]
• Numerous bug fixes
• Changed the fire elementals puzzle. Now they do not grow back when you fire them up.
• Upgraded the mirrors puzzle: wider, bigger, and easier to operate.
• Added Shaman to all the levels. Now he will explain how to pass the new puzzles in the game.
• Added times to all the challenges and levels. Now it is easier to pass a level within the time limit.
• Changed camera angles on almost all the levels to make it easier to operate and understand.
• Improved a number of puzzles and mechanics.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/4bb392f8dcaa41939018bc3c36fb452f08d9168f.gif"]
• Performance and optimization improvements;
• Network performance improvements.
• Changed Steam version to use Steam P2P as a default Network Solution. If you would like to play cross-platform (with GOG, EGS, or consoles), please change it to EGS in the game options.
• Console versions on PS4/5, Xbox and Nintendo Switch will be updated later next week. We will definitely let the players know when it is done.
That’s all for now: please stay tuned for more updates, adventurers!

In the Electric Circuit challenge, blocks sometimes could not be reinserted into the circuit, as the robot would not rotate them - fixed.

Console versions on PS4/5 have been updated. Xbox will be updated on Monday, and the Switch version will be updated within two weeks. Players no longer need to change their Steam branch to play online with console versions of the game.
That’s all for now: please stay tuned for more updates, adventurers!

Hello, adventurers!
As many of you already know, we're working hard on improving Biped 2 in every way. We've already shared some new mechanics, but today we'll be covering even more changes!
Eliminating Bugs
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/91950732ed85f2e43904d67ddb733b91be520146.jpg"]

Our team has been carefully collecting feedback on Biped 2, and we're carefully reviewing each and every one of the reviews. The best way for you is to write it in the discussion so that we can easily ask questions and request additional information and data if we can't reproduce the bug on our side (this is usually needed to understand what to fix). Some issues with gameplay mechanics, level geometry, or camera angles were disruptive, and we've paid close attention to every piece of feedback that reported gameplay issues. We're pleased to announce that the game, in its current state, has gained new mechanics and lost quite a few bugs: if you quit playing due to technical issues, now's the time to come back!
More Puzzles!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/8f8d7442978aaf975f9eb02d5d21b4f45f6830fb.jpg"]

A game free of bugs and technical issues is great, but we're striving for something truly great! Brand-new puzzles and puzzles have been added to levels 10 through 17. Rotate mirrors, navigate mazes, and balance on platforms! We've even changed the game's ending to give the Bipeds' journey a truly satisfying conclusion. We're confident that the updated seventeenth level will be a memorable finale to your playthrough. And after winning the finale, you'll see global game statistics reflecting all your achievements.
Co-op Mode and Other Improvements
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983473/02c10ae12dcd4e8a8aafda85c95ede3f9fe7a069.jpg"]

Co-op mode has always been and remains a key feature of Biped 2. We've worked hard to ensure you can play with friends without lag or bugs, and in this patch, we've made a couple more useful upgrades! Direct P2P connections for Steam are now even more reliable, meaning you can focus on solving puzzles instead of worrying about an unsteady connection. We've also listened to feedback and rolled back some changes that weren't working, such as returning more familiar mechanics to level four.

This is the updated Biped 2, and we hope you enjoy it even more! Play with friends, experience familiar levels in a new light, have fun, and, of course, let us know what you think of the updated game!
Hello, adventurers!
We are pleased to present the long-awaited update for Biped 2, something that we have been working hard on!

The first six levels of the game now feature brand new challenges and mechanics. Explore familiar locations to discover new puzzles: a maze, a waterball and onslaught challenge, riddles that test your memory and logic, and much more. Play solo or with friends, and be sure to let us know what you think of the new mechanics!

In this update, we have also updated the color schemes for locations on the second and third levels and fixed an issue with the number of stars on the ninth level. We have also added a feature that will help if one of the players gets “stuck” in a location, and improved connection stability in co-op mode.

There are even more new features coming to Biped 2: they will be added to other game levels as well. We continue to work hard on improving the game and, of course, we are closely listening to your feedback!
See you soon, bipeds!

releases.displayName: A big update with brand new mechanics and puzzles is coming!

items.text: Dear adventurers!

Since the day Biped 2 was released, our dev team has been closely monitoring the state of the game and reading your feedback. It was your input that helped us realize that Biped 2 needed more fresh ideas, more brand-new puzzles, and more fun mechanics. Biped 2 was too similar to the first game, and although this is inevitable for a sequel, we decided not to leave it unaddressed.
And now we are happy to announce that the game will feature brand new mechanics and puzzles!

Navigate the mazes; solve puzzles that will test your memory and quick reactions; spin mirrors and find new ways to use the elementals. All of this will be added to the existing levels, so you'll find delightful surprises waiting for you in both the early and late stages of the game.

In total, the game will feature more than ten new mechanics, as well as time trials: when playing in co-op mode, you can test your teamwork skills in special mini-games. By completing them, you can earn gold, silver, or bronze rewards. If you've already honed your skills playing with a friend, now is the time to put them to the test!

We will definitely tell you more about the new mechanics, so stay tuned for news and follow our social media accounts! More adventures await, and we hope that both new and returning players will enjoy the updated version of Biped 2.
See you soon, bipeds!

Hello, Bipeds!
We are extremely excited to present a new demo update! We’ve got lots of feedback and made awesome changes to make Biped 2 an even better game for everyone.
So, what’s new?

Peer-to-peer online connection — no more region selections or any other shenanigans. Now, coop mode works through the P2P connection system, which should drastically improve ping. connection quality and streamline the experience;

Easy and Hard mode selection — we’ve had lots of feedback about the puzzle difficulty and a need for a more relaxed experience, akin to the first game. We’ve added a new difficulty setting, so now you are in full control of your gameplay. Challenge lovers can tackle the hard mode, and if you are here just for the vibes with your friends, the easy mode is a perfect choice for you.

Brand new PVP mode — for the first time ever, Biped will have a 2 vs 2 PVP mode. Race your friends through the levels and see who is the fastest Biped! In the Demo, you can have a taste of one level in this new mode.
Until next time, adventurers!

items.text: Hello, adventurers!

While playing the Biped 2 Demo, many of our Chinese players may have experienced issues with playing in co-op mode. We have released a small game update, and playing with friends will be more convenient and problem-free. Check out our guide to make sure your co-op adventures go great!
Once in coop mode, click on the region selection button at the bottom of the screen:
Choose the appropriate region! Remember that you and your companions must select the same region in the settings for a trouble-free game.
After that, you are totally ready to play together, conquer challenges and solve puzzles!
